title: Process Engineer - Claims Transformation
description:
Process Engineer – Claims Transformation
 
Responsibilities:
Work closely with operations to perform value stream mapping, and identify opportunities for work processes improvements
Suggest quality and productivity improvement measures to enhance operational efficiency
Develop and maintain scorecard and other tools to measure the success of process improvement initiatives
Create and periodically review metrics to capture operational performance more efficiently



Requirements:
4-6 years of developing and designing process improvement recommendations
Data analysis experience-able to gather data points and articulate to find solutions
ARIS experience
Understanding of risks and controls
Insurance claims experience is highly preferred
Experience with Generative AI is preferred

title: Digital Optimization Specialist
description:
Digital Optimization Specialist
REMOTE!!

Helps to define the business and digital testing requirements for moderately complex to complex optimization efforts.
Evaluates, plans, and organizes work and resources for the execution of digital testing solutions from concept to production release, accountable for meeting quality targets and achieving program and project milestones within established timeframes and budget.

Required:

3-5 years’ experience in a business or technical function performing quantitative qualitative analysis to make data driven business recommendations.
3-5 years of experience creating models from multiple data sources (e.g., digital internet, website, mobile) to analyze and derive recommendations to resolve business issues
4 years of experience using split-testing software such as Adobe Target, Optimizely  or VWO or similar platforms or  4 years’ experience using digital analytics software such as Site Catalyst, Google Analytics, or Web Trends.
Proven track record successfully delivering a superior digital experience and engagement strategy in the digital arena (web and mobile app); able to effectively collaborate front-end development teams; expertise in all key functional areas, including usability, UX, design, and information architecture.
Strong analytical / problem solving skills.
Ability to synthesize information for effective decision making

title: Financial Crimes Process Engineer
description:
Financial Crimes Process Engineer – REMOTE!!

Responsibilities:

Lead the development and maintenance of process maps for key processes within the Financial Crimes organization.
Maintain process documentation, ensuring accuracy and currency.
Support the organization's ongoing efforts to improve compliance with regulatory requirements.
Suggest and implement automation improvements to manual controls using RPA and/or AI solutions.

Requirements:

3+ years of experience in process engineering with a track record of designing and implementing process improvements.
3+ years of experience working in a financial crimes environment dealing with fraud/disputes
Good understanding of business risk and controls.
Strong communication skills (verbal, written, listening), with the ability to distill complex information.
Self-starter with experience independently finding solutions in ambiguous environments.
VISIO and JIRA experience

title: Business Systems Analyst (Vendor Integration)
description:
Business Systems Analyst (Vendor Integration)
 
Responsibilities:

Supplier Integration
  • Leverage your technical and vendor experience to streamline integrations (Guidewire experience is a plus, but not required)
Supplier Diversification
  • Assess and optimize our supplier portfolio
  • Bring experience in vendor/supplier management to diversify and future-proof our partnerships
Roadmaps & Scorecards
  • Build and implement data-driven scorecards to track supplier performance
  • Simplify complex metrics into clear, actionable insights for stakeholders
Requirements:
  • Strong background in supplier/vendor management
  • Solid understanding of system integrations (Guidewire or similar platforms)
  • Proven ability to take projects from inception to execution
  • Experience building processes, scorecards, and operational frameworks
  • Ability to manage multiple workstreams and prioritize effectively
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-ambiguity environment
  • Highly organized and knows how to break down complexity into simplicity
  • Honest, direct, and comfortable having tough conversations
